thread:
ravi: Running a short quantization sweep on avalon-3b-eta (q5_1 experimental) for embeddings + few-shot summarization. Initial numbers look OK for embeddings but summarization rouge-L dropped ~1.8%. Before we push packaging into Dedicated, need a licensing thumbs-up re: derivatives/redistribution.

elaine: can you paste the license link? I'll do a quick read.

ravi: https://models.example/avalon-3b-eta/LICENSE.txt. Top line says "Permissive-NonCommercialish-2.0" then later a clause: "No transfer of compiled or transformed model binaries without upstream consent". Feels like quant bins are explicitly mentioned.

marco: ops caution: Dedicated expects either an AMI/container we preload OR the customer pulls a tarball of weights. Both are redistribution. If clause covers "transformed binaries" we can't ship quant bins.

ravi: quick eval snippet: ```env: docker:prod; quant: q5_1-run; metrics:{embed_cos:0.9952, rougeL:0.642 vs 0.654 float}``` attaching full logs to ticket.

tara: product question: would Hosted-only be acceptable short-term? Hosted is paid service so NC clause may still block. Need legal read.

scan-bot: license-scan -> license=Permissive-NonCommercialish-2.0; flags=["non-commercial-like","no-transformed-binaries"]. note="Clause appears to treat quantized artifacts as transformed binaries; commercial redistribution likely prohibited without explicit upstream permission."

legal-liaison: brief read: the phrasing does seem to capture quantized weights as "transformed/compiled binaries." Short answer: we should not redistribute quant bins to paying customers without explicit permission. Options: 1) Hosted-only (but selling access may violate NC), 2) customer-provided canonical weights + our quant tool run in-customer VPC (we ship only tooling), 3) request a redistribution addendum from upstream.

marco: ops prefers option 2 or 3. Option 1 pushes high-volume inference cost onto us and may still be risky due to NC text. For 2 we need a reproducible quant tool and pinned qlib version; customers must run exact pipeline to match our SLOs.

elaine: note about reproducibility: we observed small tool-version drift in previous models. If customers run a different qlib, results vary ~0.3-0.6 pts rouge. We'll document the exact command and seed in the model card.

ravi: re tokenizer: avalon bundles a proprietary BPE with a "redistribution-limited" header. That might require separate permission to ship any artifact including headers.

legal-liaison: add tokenizer flag to request template. I'll draft a short permission request (two asks: allow redistribution of quantized derivatives for commercial use; allow shipping a deduped tokenizer derivate if necessary). Expect draft in ~6 hours.

tara: product decision: block Dedicated for avalon-3b-eta until we get permission. We'll continue Hosted internal pilot but mark the model card and onboarding note with the licensing caveat. Also include a customer-facing FAQ about why we might require them to upload weights.

marco: ops will prototype an "upload canonical weights -> run quant in customer VPC" flow and add a qlib-checker that verifies tool version and seed. We'll also add a small warning in the console about potential perf variance.

ravi: thanks. Closing for now pending legal addendum. Will reopen if legal needs full eval artifacts.
